description:
Activate Ambitious Dragonborn by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Ambitious Dragonborn enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Ambitious Dragonborn enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Ambitious Dragonborn.
